title: Shared platform-service classification
responsibility: Classifies ordinary command-owned processes as private and guards Xcode shared-service candidates; delegates a candidate only after process identity, Xcode authority and signature checks.

inputs.name: sameTime.one
inputs.description: First process start-time string to compare after whitespace normalization.

inputs.name: sameTime.other
inputs.description: Second process start-time string to compare after whitespace normalization.

inputs.name: named.names
inputs.description: Executable paths or names checked by basename against the guarded service/launcher names.

inputs.name: probing.context
inputs.description: Context whose optional ProcessProbes implementation is used, or whose cancellation signal configures the default system probes.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.known
inputs.description: PID and recorded start time of the process to classify.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.context
inputs.description: Authority callback, command process-group ID, optional process probes and cancellation signal.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.known
inputs.description: PID and recorded start time to verify immediately before signalling.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.judgedAs
inputs.description: Executable path previously judged private; null means no executable was established.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.context
inputs.description: Authority callback, group ID, optional probes and cancellation signal used for the final identity check.

outputs.name: macAuthority
outputs.description: Canonical selected Xcode developer directory and signature requirements, or null when selection cannot be established.

outputs.name: platformServices
outputs.description: Selected Xcode service authority from bounded asynchronous probes, or null if unavailable or invalid.

outputs.name: classifyProcess
outputs.description: Verdict describing gone, private, delegated or protected standing, reason and executable path.

outputs.name: stillPrivate
outputs.description: True only when PID/start time and executable still match and the executable is not a guarded service or launcher; does not signal.
